name: trend_crypto
description: Crypto trend following, moved here from a sibling project's ledger (rules frozen 2026-07-03, recorded there from 2026-07-03 to 2026-10-28 with fills at the signal close). Equal thirds of BTC, ETH and SOL; each is held while its close is above the 200-day average, sized to a 20% volatility target. This ledger fills at the next open like every other quantlab result, so it starts fresh rather than continuing the old record.

expected.source: the sibling project's 10-year backtest, fills at the signal close
expected.note: about 17% a year, Sharpe 1.23, max drawdown -14%; flat most of the time (164 entries and exits across the three assets in ten years)
